Price Treasury securities, infer yields, value scheduled liabilities, and reconcile a bond ETF holding snapshot.

## Scope

Results describe the supplied historical snapshot or a stated simulation. Model fit and scenario estimates are not evidence of performance on new observations. See the project README for the execution record and limitations.

```{r}
source("R/analytics_support.R")
set.seed(42)
```

```{r}
load("Data/treasury_market.RData")
```

```{r}
settle <- calendar_date(2025,05,03)
mature <- calendar_date(2052,11,15)
coupon <- 0.04
freq = 2
conv = 'ACT/ACT'            # daycount convention
yield  <- 0.04363
comp.freq = 2
clean.price <- bond.price(settle,mature,coupon,freq,yield,conv,comp.freq)
round(clean.price,4)
```

```{r}
settle <- calendar_date(2025,05,03)
mature <- calendar_date(2032,05,15)
coupon <- 0.02875
freq = 2
conv = 'ACT/ACT'  
comp.freq = 2
full.price <- 93.6907
accint <- bond.TCF(settle,mature,coupon,freq,conv)$accrued
clean.price <- full.price - accint
yield <- bond.yield(settle,mature,coupon,freq,clean.price,conv,comp.freq)
round(yield,4)
```

```{r}
settle <- calendar_date(2025,05,03)
mature <- calendar_date(2051,08,15)
coupon <- 0.02
freq = 2
conv = 'ACT/ACT'
comp.freq = 2
```

```{r}
df <- data.table(maturity = coupons.dates(settle,mature,freq) )       
df<-df[, coupons := coupon*100/2 ]                                        
df<-df[, principal := c(rep(0,nrow(df)-1), 100) ]                          
df
```

```{r}
colnames(ci)
setnames(ci,'price','ci.price')
colnames(ci)

colnames(sp)
setnames(sp,'price','sp.price')
colnames(sp)
```

```{r}
# Merge coupon STRIPS prices onto cash flow table
df <- merge(df, ci, by = 'maturity', all.x = TRUE)

# Merge principal STRIPS prices onto cash flow table
df <- merge(df, sp, by = 'maturity', all.x = TRUE)

# PV of each coupon = coupon * (ci.price / 100)
df <- df[, pv_coupon := coupons * ci.price / 100]

# PV of principal = principal * (sp.price / 100)
df <- df[, pv_principal := principal * sp.price / 100]

# Discounted cash flows give the full price; subtract accrued interest for clean price.
stopifnot(!anyNA(df$ci.price[df$coupons != 0]), !anyNA(df$sp.price[df$principal != 0]))
strips.full.price <- sum(df$pv_coupon, na.rm = TRUE) + sum(df$pv_principal, na.rm = TRUE)
strips.clean.price <- strips.full.price - bond.TCF(settle, mature, coupon, freq, conv)$accrued
round(strips.clean.price, 3)
```

```{r}
df <- data.table(maturity = seq(from=calendar_date(2025,11,15),to=calendar_date(2029,11,15),by="year"))
df<-df[, amount := c(100000,105000,110000,115000,120000)]
df
```

```{r}
df <- merge(df, ci, by = 'maturity', all.x = TRUE)

df <- df[, pv := amount * ci.price / 100]

df

total.pv <- sum(df$pv)
round(total.pv, 0)
```

```{r}
settle <- calendar_date(2025,05,03)

coupons <- coupons[, pmid := (pbid + pask) / 2]

tlt <- merge(TLT_holdings, coupons[, .(maturity, coupon, pmid)], by = c('maturity', 'coupon'), all.x = TRUE)

tlt <- tlt[, accint := bond.TCF(settle, maturity, coupon, freq=2, 'ACT/ACT')$accrued, by = .(maturity, coupon)]

tlt <- tlt[, full.price := pmid + accint]

tlt <- tlt[, mkt.value := face * full.price / 100]

total.mv <- sum(tlt$mkt.value) / 1e6
round(total.mv, 0)
```

## Interpretation limits

Prices are per 100 face value unless indicated. Results use the supplied historical snapshot and stated compounding conventions.
